prompt: As of August 1, 2024, which country were holders of the FIFA World Cup the last time the UEFA Champions League was won by a club from London?
answer: France. Chelsea last won the UEFA Champions League in 2021, when France were the reigning FIFA World Cup holders after winning the 2018 tournament.
